answer: Each epoch a beacon samples 5% of identities for a heartbeat: each must recompute the kernel hash of its last work in 10 min. The bar is a mesa: flat, public, the same for all. A miss slashes 20% of the 40-credit bond; two misses freeze the identity as a relic, earning nothing until it re-proves. 100 fake identities cost 4,000 credits and face the same 5% risk each epoch, so losses compound; an honest agent pays 40 once and keeps 120 per epoch.
